EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}As you can see,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'm back to my
usual chipper self!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}I'm sorry if
I worried you at all.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}That {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} gave me
really helped out.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Como ves,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} vuelvo a rebosar energía
por todos mis chakras!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Siento
haberos tenido preocupaditos.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que me dio {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}
me ha puesto las pilas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu vois, j'ai retrouvé ma forme
légendaire !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Tu ne t'es pas fait de
mauvais sang pour moi, au moins ?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que m'a donné
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} m'a fait un bien fou...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wie du siehst, geht's mir schon
wieder besser.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Tut mir leid, falls
du dir Sorgen gemacht hast...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}von {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} hat
mir wirklich geholfen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Gördüğün gibi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} her zamanki neşeli hâlime
döndüm!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Seni endişelendirdiysem
özür dilerim.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}İlaç{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} veren {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} gerçekten çok yardımcı oldu.

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} mir geht's schon
wieder besser!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}} Ich hoffe, du hast
dir nicht zu viele Sorgen gemacht.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dank der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}von {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}geht es mir schon wieder viel
besser!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I've finally recovered from my cold!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I'm sure it's because I got plenty of
rest.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Now you and I can have fun
again,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0005:0001:}} 1 - Rhume 0 !
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Il faut trois choses pour terrasser
un vilain coup de froid :{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} du repos,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}du repos,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} et encore du repos !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sono completamente guarita
dal raffreddore!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Un bel po' di riposo{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} mi ha rimesso
in forma.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ora sono pronta per darmi
alla pazza gioia,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I had a bad cold,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but thanks to the
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} gave me,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I feel
like myself again.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}It's nice to know how much
my friends care about me,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'avais un rhume carabiné, mais
grâce au {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} {{TAG:000E:000A:0600640065002000040064002700}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}},
je tiens une forme du tonnerre !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ce genre d'attention, ça met du
baume au cœur{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}quand on est au
36dessous, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich war schlimm erkältet, aber
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} hat mir {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}gegeben
und schon geht's mir wieder besser.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Es ist schön, ein wenig Zuwendung
zu bekommen, wenn man sich so
schlimm fühlt,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kötü bir soğuk algınlığım vardı,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
ama {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ilaç{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} veren {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} sayesinde{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yine
kendim gibi hissediyorum.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Arkadaşlarımın beni
bu kadar önemsediğini bilmek
çok güzel,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
He estado en cama hasta hace nada
con un constipado de narices.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Literalmente,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} bichín,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} claro.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Pero {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} se esforzó por
cuidar de mí.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Y se lo agradezco
mucho.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¡Ahora estoy como una rosa!
FR:
J'avais un rhume épouvantable,{{TAG:0003:0005:}} mais
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} s'est pli{{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0200E9000400E900650002003000}} en quatre
pour me sortir de là, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
Et maintenant, je suis la bonne
santé incarnée !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}C'est bon de
pouvoir compter sur ses amis !
DE:
Bis vor Kurzem war ich richtig
krank.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} Aber {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} hat mich
wieder gesund gepflegt.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ist doch schön, wenn man so
gute Freunde hat,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
Birkaç gün fena bir soğuk algınlığı geçirdim.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ama {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} benimle ilgilenmek
için gerçekten çok uğraştı,{{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0600680069007300060068006500720002003000}} kendi
imkânlarını zorladı.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Şimdi turp gibiyim!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD0600680069006D00060068006500720002003000}}'ın yaptığı
gerçekten çok tatlıydı,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Up until recently,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I was stuck in bed
with a really bad cold.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}I felt so low all by myself.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}But I
bundled up nice and warm,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} slept a
lot,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} and now I'm feeling better!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Acabo de recuperarme de una gripe
muy dura,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} cielo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}He tenido que tomar mucha sopita
caliente y taparme bien,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} ¡pero por
fin estoy sana como una manzana!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pendant quelques jours, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}j'étais
clouée au lit avec une fièvre de
cheval. {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Je faisais peine à voir...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Alors je me suis enveloppée sous
une dizaine de grosses couvertures,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
et j'ai enchaîné sieste sur roupillon !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tisane,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} triple doudoune et bouilloire
de compétition :{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} de quoi terrasser
toutes les affections !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Fino a poco tempo fa,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} ero a letto
con un bruttissimo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} raffreddore.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ero sola e malata. A pezzi!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ma mi
sono tenuta al caldo e ho riposato
tanto.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Devo dire{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} che ora sto meglio!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bis vor Kurzem hatte ich noch
eine ganz schlimme Erkältung.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Da ging's mir richtig schlecht.
Aber dann hab ich mich ins Bett
verkrochen, ausgeschlafen, und
jetzt geht's mir wieder gut!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yakın zamana kadar,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} çok kötü bir soğuk
algınlığı yüzünden
yataktan çıkamıyordum.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
Tek başıma kalınca moralim
çok bozulmuştu.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ama sımsıcak giyindim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bol
bol uyudum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} şimdi daha iyiyim!
